Name: Wooden Fish 2
Author: BaiYu1029
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]给佛系玩家制作的mod（？），敲木鱼可攒福报~一起来敲木鱼吧！[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]解压后放到Mods文件夹即可[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]可在皮埃尔商店和joja商店购买，每个商店限一个，卖完不补货。理论上联机可用。 木鱼需要放置在桌上，不能放在地上，每天敲木鱼可获得金币，获得金币数根据连续修行天数增加，最高一天可以获得10万金币，如果中途中断修行，需重新开始哦～每天敲击木鱼后还会获得速度+1的buff～ 鼠标左键放置或取下，右键敲木鱼修行，如果外出也可带上在物品栏也可敲击～ [/color]

Manifest.Name: Muyu Combo Fortune
Manifest.Description: A meditation wooden fish you place on a table (left-click to place/pick up, right-click to tap). Tap it once per day for growing gold that caps at 100000, plus a +1 speed buff that lasts until you sleep; miss a day and your streak resets.
Manifest.Author: BaiYu
